msg: I'm going to keep this short and simple - to get the most amount of mushrooms always choose the gnome with the following coloured hat RED, BLUE, ORANGE or GREEN.Ignore all the other colours, you are trying to get the bright forest with the red basket. Gnomes always appear with the same partner with the wrong colour - just stick to RED, BLUE, ORANGE and GREEN.Special points1. The red is more like magenta - this really threw me so don't be fooled!2. Even if you get a couple of 0 keep going with the right colours don't be tempted to switch3. NEVER forget to press the space button to collect mushroomsCONCENTRATE AND TAKE THE BREAKS - IT HELPS!
